subject: C11
required_fixes: R1 [high] Coordinate investigation/report persistence with credential cleanup and reset. crates/desktop-core/src/sessions.rs:712,743,873 starts blocking snapshot writes that can create a derived Keychain record and sealed file; authority/management_domain.rs:115 cancels the session without closing/draining these writers. authority.rs:2871 deletes the file/key independently, while Reset at authority.rs:2538 waits only for credential, learner and offline writers, excluding investigation writes and StoreReports at authority.rs:2465. An already-started spawn_blocking task survives cancellation: cleanup/reset can report success and then a retained writer can recreate deleted cache/key/report data. Acceptance: deterministically hold admitted cache writes before key creation/file placement and report writes before placement, remove/replace the credential or reset, then release them. Cleanup/reset success must guarantee that retired files/keys cannot reappear, with late writes drained or covered by orphan cleanup and no stale publication.

R2 [medium] Bind pending report saves and their settlements to the owning tenant/book lease, not only a reusable generation number. authority.rs:2465 waits for report_writer and only afterwards calls report_write(generation); authority/sessions_domain.rs:165 replaces the sole in-memory book on another tenant's OpenReports and resets its generation to zero. report_write at :320 and settle_report_write at :335 compare only generation. If an A save is waiting behind a writer when B opens its reports, A's accepted edit can disappear without ever being persisted; equal generations can also make A's effect act on B's current book/status. Acceptance: hold a writer, accept an additional A edit, switch to B and open/edit its reports, then release writes and restart. Both tenants must retain their own latest accepted changes, and A completions/failures must not alter B's save status. Preserve pending work independently of the currently displayed book.

R3 [medium] Preserve authoritative pagination when computing search completeness. crates/desktop-core/src/management.rs:1036 treats every short page as terminal even when normalize at :1207 has returned complete=false and next_offset because total_items or a cursor says more data exists; :1042 also discards the normalized cursor. A short/empty intermediate page can therefore produce a false complete absence or 'every session' claim. Acceptance: literal dashboard fixtures with short and empty pages, an explicit remaining total/cursor and a later match must either continue correctly within the registered request/session bounds or report incomplete/invalid data. They must never claim complete absence from that partial walk.

R4 [medium] Keep existing local FP/FN reports usable without a ready management credential. apps/desktop/src/features/sessions/sessions-view.tsx:102 only opens reports when ready, and :120 returns before rendering any report tab. The native report operations support selected-tenant local work independently; after restarting a session-credential profile, persisted reports become inaccessible until credentials are configured again. This violates independent reporting and C11/T23 offline local work. An independent in-memory render of the actual component with one existing report and no ready credential reproduced no reports tab and no OpenReports dispatch. Acceptance: offline restart with persisted reports and no management credential permits opening, editing, removing/undoing and exporting those reports without any management request; remote investigation and creation of new reports still require their proper authority and scan metadata.
evidence_gaps: E1 [required native export evidence] apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/adapters.rs:71 substitutes FixtureSaver, bypassing production NativeSaver at :137 and using a different no-replacement file-placement path. tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c11.py and native-acceptance.json establish fixture exports, not the NSSavePanel selection/cancellation/overwrite behavior introduced here; the packet explicitly acknowledges this. Supply source/build-bound native evidence through production NativeSaver with synthetic report/investigation inputs, covering save, cancellation with no file change, confirmed overwrite with owner-only output, and keyboard/focus behavior. No product endpoint is needed.

E2 [required C11 adverse/offline evidence] C11.md explicitly requires denial, stale credential binding, locked cache and T23 offline launch/read/edit/retry/no replay. The 13 sessions_reports cases, frontend suites and nine C11 native cases do not exercise the new investigation persistence/cache paths under locked/denied/unavailable storage, delayed reveal/load completion across credential retirement, or the feature's offline restart/local-report workflow. The sole failed-read case is a 404, and settled-write cleanup tests do not cover R1/R2. Add production-interface cases for these C11 paths and retain applicable native offline/context-switch evidence, asserting failure/outcome accuracy, no stale content publication, no plaintext fallback and explicit retry without replay. Earlier generic management/storage regressions do not establish these new paths.
optional_suggestions: O1 [nonrequired] Make mutation-probe descriptions distinguish behavioral mutations from redundant safeguards. The 'removed credential leaves its sealed investigation' probe still calls sessions::forget and only removes its success check; the timestamp probe removes ReportBook's timestamp preservation while save_report already preserves it. Both recorded survivors therefore need interpretation rather than being counted as two demonstrated product defects. Add fault injection or use the lower-level unit guard if those independent safeguards are intended to be measured.
limitations: Reviewed C11 only. Scores recognize substantial working integration, Rust-owned report construction, explicit reveal, bounded/sealed storage and reproducible evidence; lifecycle coupling (R1/R2), completeness/offline behavior (R3/R4), and mandatory evidence gaps prevent a 9/10 pass. No score was raised to satisfy an acceptance threshold.
